description: Header file defining the C++ class AudioTrackBridge, which encapsulates the Java AudioTrackBridge for Android audio playback, including methods for control, writing samples, and retrieving audio timestamps.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: Encapsulates the Java AudioTrackBridge for Android audio playback, providing methods to control playback, write samples, and retrieve audio timestamps.

methods.name: AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio track with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Static method to get the minimum buffer size in frames based on sample type, channels, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the audio track bridge is properly initialized.

methods.name: PauseAndFlush
methods.description: Pauses and flushes the audio buffer.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes audio samples to the track, overloaded for different sample formats.

methods.name: GetAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp and update time.

methods.name: GetAndResetHasAudioDeviceChanged
methods.description: Checks and resets the flag indicating if the audio device has changed.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames.
